question: What type of vegetation is found in the plateau of Meghalaya, Sahyadri and the central and southern islands of the Nicobar group?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Moist Tropical Semi-Evergreen Vegetation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **plateau of Meghalaya, Sahyadri, **and the **central and southern islands **of the** Nicobar group **are located in regions with a **tropical climate** and **abundant rainfall.**
 
• This type of climate supports the** growth of moist tropical vegetation.**
 
• Moist Tropical Semi-Evergreen Vegetation is a type of vegetation that is characterized by** trees that shed their leaves partially **during the** dry season.**
 
• This allows the trees to** conserve wate**r and survive during the dry season.
 
• The vegetation is also characterized by the presence of** epiphytes, lianas, and ferns.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dry Tropical Deciduous Vegetation:**

 
 
• This type of vegetation is found in regions with a** tropical climate** and a **distinct dry season.**
 
• Trees in this vegetation shed all their leaves during the **dry season** to** conserve water.**
 
• This type of vegetation is** not** found in the regions mentioned in the question.
 
 
 
• **Dry Tropical Thorny Vegetation**:
 
 
• This type of vegetation is found in regions with a **tropical climate** and **low rainfall**.
 
• The vegetation is characterized by the presence of** thorny shrubs and trees**.
 
• This type of vegetation is** not** found in the regions mentioned in the question.
 
 
 
• **Alpine Vegetation:**
 
 
• This type of vegetation is found in **high-altitude regions **where the** temperature is low** and the** climate is harsh. **
 
• This type of vegetation is **not** found in the regions mentioned in the question.
 
 
 
• Hence, the statement "the correct answer is option 4" is **correct.**
